title: Block/tx environment variables
why: solang on pallet-contracts has no real concept of several EVM env vars (block.number semantics, blockhash, gasleft, block.coinbase, tx.gasprice); some are stubbed, some rejected, some return different values.
hints: Read block.number / block.timestamp and return them from a query.
Use blockhash(block.number - 1) — solang may reject it entirely (COMPILE_ASYMMETRY).
msg.sender vs tx.origin across a call from alice.
